info.name: Bulk Interviews - Engage API
info.description:
Postman collection for launching bulk interviews through the PAIR engagement API.

Recommended flow:
0. Run either '0A) Search Candidates (Curate API)' or '0B) Get Candidate IDs By Job'
1. Run '1) Generate Engage Payload'
2. Run '2) Send Bulk Interview (From Generated Payload)'

Optional:
- Use request 3 if you want to paste/edit a fully custom payload manually.
